content_of_post_to_comment: When I was a teenager, all my characters were (gosh, surprise!) teenagers! As I got a little older, my characters became early twenties. Currently, my MCs (though not all characters) are in their thirties. (I have an idea for a story about a woman aged 53 — though in the story she is magically transformed back to 38, so…). I wonder, as I get older, will my characters get older too? Or will they sit in some sort of sweet spot? How old are your characters compared to you? Do you prefer writing characters of a particular age?
comment: I wonder if character age tracks the writer's age because our questions change more than our imagination does. Maybe the sweet spot isn't a number, but the life stage where we still feel unresolved.
